title: Fields are excellent
statement: Every field $k$, regarded as a commutative ring, is excellent [def-exc-excellent-ring].

proof.text: A field k is Noetherian and local with maximal ideal zero. Mathlib supplies these instances and IsAdicComplete.bot; rewrite using IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_eq_bot to obtain maximal-ideal-adic completeness [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-complete-local-g-ring] to conclude IsGRing k.

source.place: Tags 07PS and 07PX; specialize the complete-local G-ring theorem using the elementary zero-adic completeness calculation.

proof.text: Apply [lem-exc-j2-residue-field-criterion] to k. Each prime p of k equals zero and is maximal, so the residue map k to kappa(p) is surjective; hence kappa(p) is module-finite over k. For each finite purely inseparable extension L/kappa(p), transitivity makes L module-finite over k [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension]. Take B to be the top k-subalgebra of L, with its canonical algebra equivalence to L. This equivalence transfers module finiteness and regularity [lem-weil-pbc-field-regular-ring]. Every x in L is x/1 with numerator and denominator in B. The entire spectrum of B is open and nonempty (its zero ideal is prime), and every prime localization is regular local. These are precisely the finite-model hypotheses of the criterion. It follows that the regular locus of every finite type k-algebra is open.

source.place: Tag 07PJ, field case, checking condition (4) of Tag 07PC with the finite extension itself.

proof.text: Mathlib supplies regularity of a field [lem-weil-pbc-field-regular-ring]. Apply [lem-trf-regular-ring-universally-catenary] to conclude that k is universally catenary, including finite bounds and equality of saturated-chain lengths in every prime interval of every finite type k-algebra.

source.place: Tags 00NQ and 00NM: regular rings are Cohen-Macaulay and hence universally catenary; this is the regular-ring route cited in 07QW.

proof.text: Noetherianity, the G-ring condition from step 1, and J-2 from step 2 give quasi-excellence. Together with universal catenarity from step 3 this is exactly excellence [def-exc-excellent-ring].

proof_origin.place: Assembly following 07QW(1): J-2 by the field finite model of 07PJ, universal catenarity by the regular-ring consequence of 00NQ/00NM cited in 07QW, and the G-ring clause by the already proved complete-local G-ring theorem 07PS applied to the zero-adically complete field. No unit statement or realized step is bypassed.
